articles.title: Trump's Second Shot at Restricting Birthright Citizenship Sets Up New Legal Fight
articles.summary: President Trump issued two executive orders narrowing birthright citizenship, targeting children of diplomats, UN employees, and birth tourists. Legal experts say the orders clash with the 14th Amendment and will face immediate court challenges.

articles.title: A League of Their Own, For Real: Women's Pro Baseball Debuts to Roaring Crowds
articles.summary: The Women's Pro Baseball League launched its inaugural season in Springfield, Illinois, with four teams and fans traveling from as far as South Korea. The historic opening weekend featured a first pitch by 99-year-old baseball pioneer Maybelle Blair.

articles.title: Mecca Pact: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan Forge a New Defense Axis
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan signed the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, treating an attack on one as an attack on all. Analysts call it a strategic signal aimed at Iran amid the ongoing US-Israel war, though the pact names no adversary.
